blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – As the country commemorates the National Day of Remembrance for Road Crash Victims, Survivors, and Their Families on Sunday, a transport advocacy group has urged lawmakers to invest more in road safety programs to prevent further deaths on Philippine roads. The Move As One Coalition cited the deaths of 90-year-old Erlinda Santos Tagle and 11-year-old Dawn Rafael Linga, who were both hit by pickup trucks while crossing designated pedestrian lanes. Tagle was volunteering outside a church in Pampanga when a pickup truck struck her last June. Meanwhile, Linga was crossing a pedestrian lane in Oriental Mindoro when a […]...
